name: loadmore
need: Grow a long list by pages: a Load more button, or an infinite scroll that stops for the footer

--ds-loadmore-padding.description: the block padding of `.ds-loadmore` (and the side padding of `--inline`) at the comfortable density; 2px per density step

--ds-loadmore-error-color.description: the status of a load that failed (with the alert icon and the words)
